articleTitle: XGBoost Regression Algorithms for Efficient Predictions on Inventory Sales and Management
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: A combined implementation of machine learning(ML) based prediction models on the stock market using mainly Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>) regression algorithms has been researched upon. There have been existing implementations of the ML-based models in the prediction of other business models. The ML-based model called XGBoost<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup> regression algorithm is experimented as the preferred model to predict the sale amount in diverse business areas with significant efforts to testify the performance in prediction accuracy of the results. After applying the XGBoost regression algorithm to the assigned datasets on the past sales data of market for predicting the future inventory stock sales, the result has been verified as highly accurate in the test data output in the test data environment. Evaluation on the coefficient of determination (R square) shows that majority of the test results is satisfactory, which more than half of the predicted results having extremely low error rate. The deviation rate of the majority of the remaining results is also within the acceptable range. Only a few portions have a significantly large unexplainable difference which is within our expectations.<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>Extreme Gradient Boost (XGBoost) is a strong classifier, i.e. an ensemble technique in Machine Learning classification

articleTitle: Effects of Dimension Reduction Methods on Boosting Algorithms for Better Prediction Accuracies on Classifications of Stress EEGs
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: This research aims to investigate the effects of various dimension reduction methods, namely Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Independent Component Analysis (ICA) and Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) on the prediction accuracies of the stressful state in the EEG signaling when performing different mental tasks. The dataset used for this research is the SAM-40 dataset. It consists of 40 subjects performing three different mental tasks, i.e. Arithmetic Problem Solving Task, Stroop Color Word Test and Mirror Image Recognition Task. Each task was carried out with 3 trials. The results after applying the different dimension reduction methods of PCA, ICA and LDA to different boosting algorithms were analyzed and compared meticulously. These boosting algorithms are mainly the ensemble techniques of AdaBoostM1 and RUSBoost algorithms. Among all the experimented results shown, the LDA induced boosted classification methods showed the best prediction accuracy result, i.e. around $30 \%$ of prediction accuracy improvement.

articleTitle: Research on camera calibration technology of two-dimensional displacement measurement system based on single-chip microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: When it comes to displacement measurement applications that use machine vision, the accuracy of the image has a direct and significant impact on the results of the measurement analysis. Cameras are manufactured with fixed physical and optical parameters. However, due to the inherent error of the lens and the assembly process of the vision system, it is usually necessary to calibrate the camera to obtain accurate camera parameters. This process is unavoidable before using the camera for displacement measurement application. Here, we proposed a two-dimensional displacement measurement system using a single-chip microcomputer, which has the characteristics of a fixed position. In order to overcome the deficiencies of the vision system and the limitations of the calibration environment, the Tsai two-step method and Zhang Zhengyou calibration method were utilized to calibrate the camera used in the system. The project analyzed the distortion coefficient and internal and external parameters obtained from the camera calibration process, and used this information to correct the distortion of the captured images. The experiments demonstrated that the Zhang Zhengyou calibration method provided better robustness and accuracy for the system, which ultimately helped to improve the accuracy of the two-dimensional displacement measurement.

articleTitle: Coseismic Deformation Monitoring for Luding Strong Earthquake by means of Lutan-1 SAR Satellites
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Lutan-1 SAR satellite is the first group differential interferometric SAR satellites in China which consists of two identical multi-polarimetric L-band SAR. Due to the precise orbit control ability and high revisit feature, surface deformation monitoring with centimeter even millimeter accuracy may be achieved. On 5 September 2022, an Ms6.8 magnitude earthquake occurred in Luding County, Sichuan Province, China. In combination with the pre-earthquake and post-earthquake Lutan-1 SAR data over Luding area, the coseismic deformation monitoring was implemented and analyzed. Owing to the characteristics of long wavelength, high coherence of Lutan-1 SAR data was obtained over the study area covered by dense vegetation. The experimental results indicated that valid coseismic deformation field was extracted. The maximum displacement of Xianshuihe fault zone is reached to 20 centimeters. The results demonstrated the ability of Lutan-1 SAR data for quantitative application with earthquake monitoring.

articleTitle: Distribution Cable Partial Discharge Hybrid Noise Suppression Method based on Adaptive Dual Complementary Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Due to the complex interference environment, partial discharge (PD) monitoring signal filtering of noise and interference signals is a necessary step to determine the insulation status of equipment. This paper proposes a method for optimizing filtering based on time-frequency analysis. Since pure partial discharge signals and periodic narrowband noise have different intermediate frequency positions and partial discharge signals usually have burst characteristics, time-frequency diagrams can be used to extract burst intermediate frequency characteristic signals to filter narrowband interference, and innovatively decompose wavelet It is implanted into the convolutional neural network to expand its receptive field, and at the same time, a double complementary convolutional network is used to restore the details and structure of the time-frequency diagram as much as possible, so as to realize the widely distributed white noise data part and the effective signal data in the sampled data. Partially separated, the effectiveness of this method was verified through numerical simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Flat Coherence Metric Based InSAR Phase Estimation for Distributed Scatterers
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: State-of-the-art methods in phase linking (PL) for distributed scatterer interferometry (DSI) extract consistent phase histories from coherence matrices, either based on sample matrices or those with calibrated magnitudes. However, the reliability of sample coherence as an estimator diminishes in scenarios involving large-dimensional data. To address this limitation, we introduce a novel PL approach, termed LaMIE, specifically designed for precise phase history retrieval from large-dimensional coherence matrices in DSI. In this context, “large-dimensional” denotes instances where the temporal dimension N of coherence matrices aligns with the number P of statistically homogeneous pixels (SHP). LaMIE comprises two key steps: 1) shrinking the sample coherence matrix, and 2) executing phase history retrieval through the flat coherence metric. Our proposed method’s efficacy is rigorously validated through experiments using both simulated and real data, demonstrating superior performance when compared to existing PL techniques. Through the implementation of LaMIE, the densities of selected points with stable phases witness significant improvement, allowing for the retrieval of displacement velocities in more regions than achievable with current SOTA methods.

articleTitle: Sensorless Control of PMSM Based on A Novel Adaptive Gain Super Twisting Algorithm-Sliding Mode Observer
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: In the sensorless control system of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSM), the traditional first-order sliding mode observer (SMO) exhibits significant observation errors and system oscillations across varying speed ranges. Leveraging the super twisting algorithm, a design was formulated that places the switching function in the higher-order derivatives of the sliding variable, ensuring system stability and addressing oscillations.To resolve the limitations of fixed gain SMO, which inaccurately accommodate different speeds and loads, a novel adaptive gain that varies with speed and load changes was developed. This adaptive gain aims to enhance the accuracy of motor speed and rotor position observation. Stability was verified through the global bounded conditions of the super twisting algorithm. Simulation comparisons demonstrated that the novel adaptive gain super twisting algorithm-sliding mode observer (STA-SMO) significantly improves observation accuracy and reduces system oscillations.

articleTitle: Thermal Coupling Model of Lithium Battery Based on Electrochemical Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: In this paper, firstly, the electrochemical model of lithium battery is introduced, secondly, the thermal model is introduced, and the electrochemical model and thermal model are coupled, and finally the proposed homogeneous electrochemical and electrochemical-thermal coupling models are verified by the recording of the terminal voltage of a single lithium battery, respectively.

articleTitle: PSO Autofocusing for UAV SAR Motion Compensation
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: The motion error caused by the deviation from the ideal track in the actual flight of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) synthetic aperture radar (SAR) affects the azimuth focusing. This paper proposes a motion compensation method based on particle swarm optimization (PSO) autofocusing. Compared with the conventional minimum entropy autofocusing, this method has strong global optimal exploration ability, and uses genetic multi-crossover operator to improve the convergence of PSO. In the case of low signal-to-clutter ratio (SCR), the performance of the proposed method is better than the conventional autofocusing method.

articleTitle: A False Alarm Mitigation Method for Multi-pass SAR CCD
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Coherent change detection (CCD) identifies faint changes of the scene by detecting low coherence regions from two or more complex SAR images. One particular problem with the extreme sensitivity of CCD is the presence of false alarms introduced by low SNR (e.g. shadows, water bodies, etc.) and time-sensitive areas (e.g. shrubs and trees). The clutters caused by the above sources make it difficult to discriminate the concerned change target (man-made activity, e.g. footprints or vehicle tracks) from the difference image. In the image stacks acquired on the same geographical area at different times, the concerned change target is only a low coherence between the two adjacent images at the time of change occurred. In the sequences of the images acquired before or after that change occurred, the coherence of that region is usually comparable to the quiescent (or surrounding no change) coherence which is determined by the system and the ground scene. However, the coherence of clutters which determined by the random noise of the system or the random disturbance of ground objects is always low in the sequence of images obtained at any time. In this paper, a novel multi-pass log likelihood change statistic (LLCS) method is proposed to improve the sensitivity of the coherence detector while reducing the amount of false-alarms. This method jointly analyzes the difference of statistical characteristics between the concerned change target and the clutter region in the multi-pass image stacks. Theoretical analysis and data processing confirm the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Epitaxial growth of perovskite single crystal photodiode array based on space limitation method
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Organic inorganic composite perovskite has the advantages of high carrier mobility, long carrier lifetime, and long carrier diffusion length as a new type of optoelectronic material, which is widely used in solar cells, light-emitting diodes, photodetectors, and other fields. Besides, the photoelectric performance of organic inorganic composite perovskite single crystals have been further improved due to their few defects and no grain boundaries, which indicates that single crystal research is of great significance. In recent years, various organic inorganic composite perovskite single crystal diodes have been continuously reported, and there is a trend towards further development towards arrays. However, most of the existing research is on the same type of photodiode array, which has not formed multichannel photodetection devices. Therefore, this paper uses the space limitation method to epitaxial grow $2 * 2 \mathrm{MAPbBr}_{3}$ single crystals on MAPbCl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> single crystal substrate to form a single crystal photodiode array, aiming to lay the foundation for achieving multi-channel photoelectric detection in the future.

articleTitle: Noise Reduction of Partial Discharge Detection of Gas Insulation Switchgear via Time-Frequency Matrix-based Singular Value Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Partial discharge (PD) has been proven to be an effective way to assess the insulation condition of gas insulation switchgear. However, achieving acceptable levels of sensitivity and accuracy of on-site PD measurement is yet a challenging task, primarily due to various field noise interferences, mainly including white noise and discrete spectrum noise. This paper proposes a novel PD de-noising algorithm based on short-time Fourier transform and singular value decomposition. The time-frequency transformation helps distinguish the functional patterns of the PD signal from any overlapping white noise and discrete spectrum noise. Additionally, the matrix decomposition feature helps segregate and filter out the various signal components based on their significance while eliminating the presence of noise. The de-nosing results from the measured PD signals show the algorithm’s excellent performance than the classical approaches.

articleTitle: A Control Strategy for Electric Vehicles Participating in Frequency Regulation Considering User Demand and Battery Longevity
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Large-scale electric vehicle access provides a strong guarantee for power grid frequency regulation, but less consideration is given to the single-vehicle battery differences and different needs of users in the frequency regulation process. This paper addresses the above problems, considers the communication delay, and designs an auxiliary frequency regulation control method for electric vehicles based on vehicle information feedback. Firstly, the operation of the vehicle is divided according to the vehicle information. Secondly, considering the communication delay, the high-frequency component of the frequency regulation signal is allocated to the electric vehicle through a filter. Besides, the auxiliary frequency regulation of the electric vehicle is realized by using capacity allocation and adaptive sag control. Finally, the simulation verification is carried out by taking the three-area interconnected power system connected to the grid of wind power generation as an example. The results show that the designed frequency regulation control method effectively suppresses the fluctuation of frequency deviation when wind power is gridconnected while taking into account the vehicle’s individual information, and also has a significant effect on suppressing the frequency deviation under the random perturbation of load.

articleTitle: a CNN-Attention-LightGBM Arrester Defect Prediction Method based on Multi-model Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Lightning arresters are key protection equipment in power systems, and their degradation and latent defects may pose potential threats to the safety and reliability of the power system. Therefore, it is of vital significance to achieve accurate prediction of potential defects of arresters. However, traditional single models based on machine learning often struggle to achieve accurate results when predicting arrester defects. To solve this problem, this study proposes a CNN-AttentionLightGBM arrester defect prediction method based on multimodel fusion. Through this method, we are able to extract key features that affect the operating status of the arrester and use CNN for feature extraction. Among them, the Attention mechanism can increase the weight of key features and integrate it with the LightGBM prediction model. Such fusion enables accurate identification of arrester defect types. By analyzing actual monitoring and detection data, we verified the feasibility and correctness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Synthesis and Characterization of Broadband Near-Infrared Quantum Cutting Nanoparticles BaAl2O4:Eu2+,Nd3+ for Silicon Solar Cells
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: In this work, $\mathrm{Eu}^{2+}-\mathrm{Nd}^{3+}$ co-doped broadband near-infrared quantum cutting phosphors BaAl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> were prepared using the combustion and solid-state method. The morphology, internal structure, and photoluminescence properties of the phosphors were analyzed by scanning electron microscopy (SEM), X-ray diffraction (XRD), UV-vis diffuse reflectance spectroscopy, and photoluminescence spectroscopy. The SEM images exhibited that the particle size of the phosphors was approximately several hundred nanometers. The XRD analysis revealed that doping a slight amount of rare-earth ions had no effect on the crystal structure of BaAl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, and the samples presented the hexagonal structure of BaAl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>. The absorption properties of the phosphors were characterized using diffuse reflectance spectroscopy, and the phosphors displayed a broad absorption in the range of 200-480 $\mathbf{n m}\left(\mathrm{E u}^{2+}: \mathrm{4 f}^{\boldsymbol{7}} \rightarrow \mathrm{4 f}^{\mathrm{6}} \mathrm{5} \mathrm{d}^{\mathrm{1}}\right.$). In addition, multiple strong narrow-band absorption peaks appeared in the $480-850 \mathrm{~nm}$ range, attributed to the f-f transitions of $\mathrm{N d}^{3+}$. Finally, under 350 nm excitation ($\mathrm{E u}^{\mathrm{2 +}}$: $\mathrm{4 f}^{7} \rightarrow \mathrm{4 f}^{6} 5 \mathrm{~d}^{1}$), the emission of $\mathrm{Eu}^{2+}$ in the visible range as well as the emission of $\mathrm{N d}^{3+}$ in the near-infrared range was observed, demonstrating the existence of energy transfer from $\mathrm{Eu}^{2+}$ to $\mathrm{N d}^{3+}$. The phosphors have excellent optical properties and can be used on the surface of silicon solar cells to enhance their photoelectric conversion efficiency (PCE).

articleTitle: Cable Fault Identification Method Based on mRMR and Optimized Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Cable fault identification is one of the important tasks in power system maintenance. When a cable fault occurs, timely and accurate identification of the fault location can effectively reduce power outage time and improve the reliability of the power grid. This paper proposes a cable fault identification method based on a combination of mRMR model and optimized convolutional neural network. First, cable fault characteristic information is extracted from the time domain and frequency domain for fault current, and then the mRMR algorithm is used to filter out the characteristic information with a greater impact. The filtered feature quantities are used as input, and the chaotic particle swarm algorithm is used to calculate the volume. Optimize the parameters of the neural network model. Finally, the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method were verified through simulation experiments. Experimental results show that this method can accurately identify cable faults. Therefore, this method has practical application value and can be applied in power system maintenance.

articleTitle: Control Parameter Analysis of AC/DC Systems Based on Input to State Stability Theory and Regression Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: With the inevitable trend of renewable energy generation and DC transmission in modern power systems, the risk of AC and DC faults leading to high-power shocks and thus large-scale chain off-grid of new energy units, or even leading to system collapse, is increasing. Currently, there is room for further improvement in the control performance of traditional control methods due to issues such as control cost and control complexity. Meanwhile, the current power system security and stability analysis methods are difficult to support the quantitative assessment of the power grid stability level under a high proportion of new energy scenarios. Therefore, in this paper, based on the consideration of the interpretability of the algorithm, a control parameter analysis method for AC/DC systems based on Input to State Stability Theory and Regression Decision Tree is proposed, and simulations are carried out in a simplified system to authenticate the efficacy of the introduced method.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of the Front End for the Transformer State Intelligent Sensing System Based on Ant Design Vue
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: The transformer is a key equipment of the power systems, which undertake some important works in power systems, such as the energy conversion, energy transmission and its like. The transformer state intelligent sensing system is a useful tool to monitor the health state of the transformer based on many health indexes, and ensure the operation stability of the transformer, and thus can improve the operation stability of the whole power systems. Aiming at the design problems of the transformer state intelligent sensing system, this paper provides the design and implementation of the front end for the transformer state intelligent sensing system based on Ant Design Vue. In this paper, firstly the business demand of the transformer state intelligent sensing system is introduced. Secondly, the layout design of the transformer state intelligent sensing system is presented. At last, the implementation of web pages for the transformer state intelligent sensing system is given. By using Ant Design Vue components, Vue components, Echarts components, DataV components, and different combinations of above components, some business modules can be obtained, such as panorama display service, trend analysis service, status assessment service, health diagnosis service, and horizontal comparison service. This paper also provides some experience and reference for the design of front end for corresponding online monitoring system.

articleTitle: Influence of DC Component on DC GIS Gap Breakdown under AC and DC Superimposed Voltages
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: In UHV (Ultra High Voltage) DC transmission, the valve-side equipment of the converter valve and converter transformer will be subjected to AC and DC voltages as well as AC and DC superimposed voltages with complex waveforms during the working period. The above situation challenges the insulation within the converter valve equipment. Based on the typical insulation structure of DC GIS (Gas Insulated Switchgear), this paper carries out AC and DC superimposed voltage experiments and studies the influence of DC component on the gap breakdown characteristics of DC GIS. The experimental results show that: In the positive polarity of the AC and DC superposition voltage, with the DC component gradually increased, the amplitude of the breakdown voltage by the AC breakdown voltage gradually increased and then remain unchanged. The distribution of breakdown voltage shows the change rule from normal distribution to bimodal distribution and then to normal distribution. In the negative polarity of dc and ac superposition voltage, with the increase of dc component, the amplitude of the breakdown voltage presents the trend of increasing firstly and then maintaining in the vicinity of DC breakdown voltage basically unchanged. And the distribution of breakdown voltage shows the change rule of normal distribution to bimodal distribution and then to normal distribution.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Lateral Contrast in Different Edge Detection Algorithms for Micro-deformation Monitoring of Large-scale Boiler Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: In this paper, we have conducted a comparative study of different algorithms for edge detection in the monitoring of small deformations in large-scale boiler equipment. By comparing the performance of different algorithms, we evaluate their accuracy and stability in detecting small deformations based on qualitative indicators. Through a series of experiments and data analysis, we assess the suitability and feasibility of commonly used edge detection algorithms in monitoring small deformations in large-scale boiler equipment.

articleTitle: A Study of the States Kinetics in NBTI and HCI Degradation based on TCAD
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: The evaluation of MOSFET reliability requires aging model, which based on time-consuming and costly aging test. In order to reduce the costs of aging test, the parameters of trap (TP) and two-stage (TS) degradation models in TCAD framework were calibrated according to the data of aging test in this paper. Then the impact of parameters on the number of interface trap during degradation in PMOS were studied by using the two models. The results show that the calibrated model can basically replace the aging test and evaluate the lifetime of device. Finally, this paper proposed a decoupling method of hot carrier injection (HCI) and negative bias temperature instability (NBTI) by studying the relationship between the two effects and channel length. The purpose of this paper is to analyze the characteristic of aging effect through TCAD simulation and obtain the data establishing aging model. It provides convenience to the design of high-reliability device.

articleTitle: An Infrared Temperature Measurement System for Power Equipment based on Simple Multi-point Spatial Calibration Method
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: In order to meet the monitoring requirements of different over-heat spots of power equipment in narrow and complex spaces, an Infrared Temperature Measurement System (ITMS) based on multi-point spatial calibration is proposed in this paper. The system is consisted of a three-axis motion platform, a pan-tilt and an infrared thermometer. The temperature acquisition at any position is realized through a five-degree-of-freedom motion controller, and also the real-time online cycle monitoring of multiple over-heat spots is realized. Several temperature measurement experiments were finished of single and multiple heat source. The accuracy and repeatability of the temperature measurement system are proved by these experiments, and the function of multi-degree-of-freedom cyclic temperature measurement is realized. This technological innovation is expected to improve the reliability and safety of power equipment.

articleTitle: Numerical Investigation on Structural Topology and Electrical Properties of Neuromorphic Nanowire Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: The ability to understand the emergent dynamics within neuromorphic nanowire networks would significantly augment their applications and performance optimization. In this work, a numerical simulation approach combining graph theory with the HSPICE memristor circuit type model is proposed to capture and track the fundamental structural topology and electrical properties of the neuromorphic nanowire network. Numerical simulation results show that the increase in nanowire density can improve the structural topology metrics and the electrical features. In addition, the reduction of activation voltage can be related to the decrease of characteristic path length and the improved global efficiency. This may be attributed to the consequent decreased number of junctions in a percolative connectivity “winner-takes-all” path and the improved efficiency of the network in processing and transmitting current. This work provides further insights that help optimize neuromorphic nanowire networks in neuromorphic applications for achieving better performance.

articleTitle: Development of LiDAR Navigation and BLE-RSSI Indoor Positioning for an Accident-Response Home-Bot
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: The assistance and convenience of smart robotics drive industries to develop autonomous and interactive robots. Addressing such robotics enhancement, an autonomous accident-response home robot was developed by integrating two systems: the BLE-RSSI trilateration for its person tracking and the LiDAR SLAM for its path guidance. The created home robot can conquer 3-level accident-enactment setups. Results yield a $97.4 \%$ success rate for the IR sensory system, $91.1 \%$ for the IPS, $98.9 \%$ for the rally point arrival of the robot, and $98.3 \%$ for exit procession. Consolidation of the BLE-RSSI IPS and LiDAR-IR navigation system has enabled a proficient $86.3 \%$ accident-response capability of the robot.

articleTitle: SVAE-WGAN Data Augmentation Method for Partial Discharge Fault Detection of 5G based Power Intelligence System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Partial discharge is one of the most popular fault in power system, and the popularity of 5 G makes it possible to analyze partial discharge faults using artificial intelligence algorithms. Low frequency and high collection cost of partial discharge faults lead to the problems of small sample size and imbalance sample, which bring challenges to partial discharge fault detection of 5G based power intelligence system. Hence, in this paper, an data augmentation method that named SVAEWGAN is proposed, which based on stacked variational autocoding and Wasserstein generative adversarial network for partial discharge fault samples in transmission lines to generate fault samples and improve the diversity of samples. Firstly, the stack variational autoencoder is used to extract the depth features of the fault waveform. Secondly, a partial discharge fault sample generation model is constructed by combining stacked variational autocoding and Wasserstein generative adversarial network, and a partial discharge fault detection framework based on the data augmentation method is proposed. Finally, the performance of partial discharge fault detection algorithm based on LightGBM and Bi-LSTM-Attention before and after using data augmentation method is compared and analyzed based on VSB fault detection dataset by selecting accuracy and F1 score, etc. Experiments show that the data augmentation method can effectively improve the performance of partial discharge fault detection, which proves the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Monocular 2D Displacement Measurement System Based on STM32F407
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: In the context of the increasingly progressive industrial development, in order to ensure the safety and efficient of industrial production needs, it is particularly important to carry out automatic two-dimensional displacement monitoring for large structures such as specific devices and pipelines in the industry. In view of the shortcomings of the existing monitoring system, this paper presents a monocular two-dimensional displacement measurement system based on single chip microcomputer, which not only guarantees the accuracy, but also greatly reduces the cost of 2 D displacement monitoring. This method first preprocesses the image. To get the edge information, the circle detection method based on Hough transform will be used to obtain the pixel coordinate information of the target circle, and the world coordinate of the plate target circle center will be solved by using the pixel coordinate relationship between the known reference circle and the target circle. In order to verify the effectiveness of the system in the corresponding application scenarios, a test platform is build to test the system. The results show that the measurement error can be controlled within 1 mm.

articleTitle: Electro-optical Modulation Properties of Holographic Polymer Dispersed Liquid Crystal Gratings
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Holographic Polymer Dispersed Liquid Crystal (HPDLC) gratings can convert incident light from diffraction to transmission under an applied driving electric field. Therefore, it is expected to be used as a new type of volume holographic diffraction grating to electrically control the output of images matching the ambient light intensity. In H-PDLC gratings, liquid crystal microdroplets dispersed in the polymer matrix are difficult to change their orientation under the anchoring energy of the substrate and polymer matrix, which leads to a high driving voltage. The effect of refractive index modulation and liquid crystal director on the diffraction efficiency were simulated and investigated in this paper. In addition, the optimized H-PDLC grating diffraction efficiency of $\mathbf{9 7. 2 \%}$ was obtained by adding the nonionic surfactant SPAN80. When the concentration of SPAN80 was $6 \%$, the threshold field intensity compared to the un-doped surfactant grating, decreased from $15 \mathrm{~V} / \mu \mathrm{m}$ to $1.37 \mathrm{~V} / \mu \mathrm{m}$.

Author Keywords: holographic polymer dispersed liquid crystal gratings

articleTitle: Prediction of Coronary Artery Calcification Score Based on Improved U-Net and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Coronary angiography images are widely used in the diagnosis and treatment of cardiovascular diseases. Coronary artery calcification is one of the main causes of cardiovascular disease. When segmenting coronary artery calcification, the widely used U-Net network cannot obtain ideal results due to the imbalance between the foreground calcification area and the background. In addition, the calcification segmentation results of a single image cannot truly reflect the calcification situation of a patient. To address these issues, we propose a patient calcification score estimation method based on U-Net and LSTM. Firstly, a new loss function is introduced in the $\mathrm{U}-\mathrm{Net}$ network to reduce the effect of imbalanced positive and negative samples. Secondly, Input the segmentation results of multiple body positions into the LSTM network for predicting calcification scores. The experiment shows that the improved U-Net network has good calcification segmentation ability and high accuracy. The recall and IOU of calcification segmentation are $73 \%$ and $66 \%$, respectively. The correlation coefficient between the predicted value of calcification score and the true value is 0.56. There is a clear linear relationship between the predicted calcification score value and the true value.

articleTitle: Design and Reliability Analysis of Spaceborne Microsystem SiP
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: System-in-Package (SiP) is a technology that integrates multiple functional chips into a single substrate through micro-assembly, offering advantages such as compact size, high packaging efficiency, compatibility, and low power consumption. As a crucial control component for satellite in orbit, the spaceborne processor requires high performance integration and compactness. Utilizing SiP to form a microsystem with the spaceborne processor can efficiently fulfill these requirments. However, as the integration level and signal frequency increase, SiP must address signal integrity and power supply stability concerns to ensure its reliability. Furthermore due to the long-term reliability demands of aerospace SiP in specific environments, optimizing the packaging process is necessary, alongside enhancements in heat dissipation and mechanical stability. This paper presents the design of a microsystem SiP tailored for spaceborne processors, accompanied by simulation analysis to evaluate its signal integrity, power integrity, heat dissipation, and stress-all of which conform to the reference standards.

articleTitle: Environmentally Friendly Optimization of Coupled Power-Transportation Network considering Mixed Traffic Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: The explosive growth of electric vehicles makes the deep coupling between the power distribution network and the urban transportation network, in which the mixed flow consisting of electric vehicles and conventional gasoline vehicles exposes the coupled network to operational problems of congestion and carbon emission overruns. Considering this, this paper constructs an environmentally friendly oriented optimization model for coupled power and transportation networks. Specifically, the mixed flow in a coupled network is considered, the charging price is optimized to guide the charging behavior of electric vehicle users, and the carbon emission cost is adopted to schedule the routes of gasoline vehicles. To solve the optimization model of the coupled network, an accelerated Gauss-Seidel algorithm is designed to obtain the equilibrium state of the entire system, the optimization problems of both networks are solved in an iterative manner and eventually converge to the equilibrium state. A coupled power and transportation network consisting of a modified IEEE-33 bus distribution network and a 20 link transportation network is conducted as a case study, and the impact of charging prices and carbon emissions on the operational strategies of coupled networks is analyzed. The effectiveness of the proposed environmentally friendly oriented optimization model in promoting the cost reduction and flow equilibrium of the coupled network is verified.

articleTitle: Fingerprint and Face Authentication Portable Digital Electronic Voting Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: The paper presents the Electronic Voting Machine (EVM) device to facilitate digital elections with the use of Raspberry Pi as its brain. It is developed to reduce paper wastage and prevent fraud and ghost voting in contrast to the Paper Ballot System. The EVM is designed to authenticate the voter through fingerprint or face authentication. The face authentication method is incorporated with an anti-spoofing technique. Local Binary Pattern Histograms (LBPH) and Haar-Cascade Classifier models were used to detect and recognize faces and eye-blink counters for anti-spoofing. Both authentications were combined and incorporated into the voting graphic user interface (GUI), programmed through Python and its libraries to create the EVM, wherein the voter must authenticate through fingerprint or face recognition if they failed the prior method. The accuracy tests resulted in an overall 80% and 95.56% accuracy for fingerprint and face authentication, respectively. The anti-spoofing technique resulted in an overall accuracy of 100%. The mock elections of 20 voters conducted to test the functionality of the EVM resulted in an 80% fingerprint authentication success rate, while 100% of the remaining 20% passed the face authentication. Those who failed the fingerprint authentication proceeded to face authentication, resulting in an overall 100% success rate in the authentication of all voters. The database results matched the receipt of the voters, demonstrating the device’s overall efficiency of 100%. In conclusion, the paper proposes an efficient and secure EVM that ensures fair and transparent digital elections.

articleTitle: An Energy-Efficient Architecture of Approximate Softmax Functions for Transformer in Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Recently, Transformer models have provided better accuracy than traditional models in fields such as computer vision (CV) and natural language processing (NLP). However, compared with traditional convolutional neural networks (CNNs), a large number of softmax function calculations in Transformer models involve expensive exponential and division calculations, resulting in huge consumption of computing and storage resources and waste of power consumption, which makes Transformer networks unable to be effectively applied to edge computing. To solve this problem, in this paper an approximate softmax computation architecture is proposed. Compared with the classic base-e softmax function or the base-2 softmax function proposed in recent years, our proposed design uses simpler shift and fixed-point addition operations to replace complex exponential and division operations, and thus significantly reduces the resource consumption while maintaining a high computation accuracy. The proposed architecture can effectively accelerate the Softmax computation of Transformer models in edge computing. Experimental results show that for 16-bit Softmax computation, the proposed design can achieve less resource occupation and energy consumption. Vision transformer(ViT) models are also used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method in real transformer models.

articleTitle: Efficient Approximate 4-2 Compressors and Error Compensation Strategies for Approximate Multipliers
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Approximate computing is widely used to trade off computation precision for improved performance and energy efficiency. As multiplier is one of the most frequently used arithmetic units in digital systems, the design of approximate multiplier has gained much attention. Among all approximate multiplication techniques, designing approximate compressor for partial product accumulation is one of the popular choices. However, current designs do not comprehensively analyze error characteristics so that there is still a large space to improve the resource efficiency for compressors. In this paper, two (4,2)-approximate compressor architectures are proposed for energy efficient approximate multipliers. The first design only contains two OR gates which significantly improves the resource consumption of the multiplier but the approximation error is relatively large. To reduce its approximation error, the second compressor is proposed by adding error correction circuits to the first design. However, this may lead to an increase in the area of the multiplier. To keep the multiplier area to be small, an efficient error compensation strategy is proposed by analyzing the error characteristics in the scope of the whole multiplier array. Finally, by using the proposed compressors, efficient approximate multiplier architectures are proposed. Implementation results show that the proposed design can achieve much better hardware metrics while maintaining low approximation errors when compared with previous designs. The proposed designs are also applied in image sharpening application to verify their effectiveness.

articleTitle: Two-stage Optimal PMU Placement Considering Renewable Hosting
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: The rapid growth of distributed energy resources (DERs) has highlighted the importance of state monitoring for distribution networks. Notably, overvoltage frequently arises when a large amount of renewable power is injected into a single node, presenting a challenge to distribution systems. The Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) stands out as a pivotal technology that greatly enhances network observability. However, the deployment of PMUs in practical applications still has open questions in distribution systems. One of these challenges arises from the multitude of possible solutions for optimal PMU placement (OPP), primarily due to the radial topology of distribution networks. Another challenge stems from the observability robustness for renewable hosting nodes, resulting in redundant PMU deployment for the observability post-contingency. To tackle these challenges, this work proposes a two-stage OPP approach that considers renewable hosting node post-contingency observability. To validate the effectiveness of our approach, we conduct simulations using both IEEE testing systems and a real-world distribution feeder. These simulations provide empirical evidence of the benefits of the proposed OPP model and demonstrate its applicability in practical scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Face Image Denoising Method Based on Adaptive Bidimensional Empirical Mode Decomposition and Stochastic Resonance Method
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Face recognition technology has a wide range of application prospects, and important application value in content-based retrieval, digital video processing and visual detection. However, the noise in the process of image acquisition will directly affect the recognition ability of face image, and the stochastic resonance theory can convert the specific intensity of noise signal energy into useful signals. Therefore, this paper proposes an image processed method based on adaptive bidimensional empirical mode decomposition (BEMD) and stochastic resonance (SR) theory is used to improve the quality of noised face images. The noised face image is decomposed by adaptive BEMD algorithm, and multiple Intrinsic mode function (IMF) components and residual are obtained. The three IMF components containing the least feature information are selected and deleted by threshold parameters. After the remaining IMFs and the residual is reconstructed, the noise energy is transferred to the image features by SR. Meanwhile, the optimal parameters of the two-dimensional stochastic resonance system are automatically obtained by taking the Peak signal to noise ratio (PSNR) as the detection index, so as to realize the quality of the face image. Four different methods are used to improve 50 face images with glasses and 50 face images without glasses. Compared with the BEMD algorithm, median filter and mean filter, the face image data set improved by the method proposed in this paper has the highest PSNR, which improves the image quality.

articleTitle: A Review of Face Recognition Methods Based on Lightweight Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Electronics and Electrical Engineering Technology (EEET)
abstract: Face recognition has always been a research hotspot in the field of artificial intelligence. Although the most advanced methods are mainly deep learning methods based on convolutional neural networks, the huge computational overhead is also the main factor restricting its application. While improving the accuracy rate, reducing the computing and storage overhead of deep neural networks is a very important and challenging problem in the field of face recognition. Therefore, it is very important to study the face detection and recognition method based on lightweight network and design highly discriminative feature representation. This paper first introduces the recognition methods of face recognition, including traditional recognition methods and quantified recognition methods, and summarizes the advantages and disadvantages of face recognition. Then the representative data sets and commonly used evaluation indexes in the field of lightweight neural networks are combed. Finally, the development trend of lightweight neural network face recognition technology is forecasted.
